plurals.item: %d reading is outside your usual range
%d readings are outside your usual range

resources.string: Every reading with a usual range is inside it
Your usual ranges are still being learned
Ranges come from your own last 30 days. A reading outside one is a prompt to notice how you feel, not a diagnosis.
Each reading is compared with your own range from the last 30 days: your average, plus and minus one standard deviation. Until enough nights exist, Apex shows no range and no flag.
The small arrow beside a value shows which side of your average it is on. Tap a reading to see its trend.
Some overnight readings, such as the two heart-rate-variability frequency bands, are night averages of raw samples and have no range.
